name: Luk Fu
summary: Three-handed trick-taking game with single and multi-card tricks where players aim to win six card-points worth of tricks.
rules_text: Use 36 cards of a Chinese money deck in four suits: Tens high, Myriads, Knots, Coins low, plus ranked Aces and an Extra Ace. Deal 12 cards each to three active players anticlockwise; dealer is Master and leads first. With four, dealer gets one face-down card and does not play. After deal Master may lead or pass; each other in turn may pass or say Play and become Vulnerable. If all three pass, redeal to next dealer. Leader leads 1 card or a multitrick: 2+ cards played together as one trick. Others must follow with the same number of cards, if able following suit rules and Old Card rules where Nines and top remaining cards are highest. Highest card of the led suit or set wins the trick and counts for as many points as cards in it. First to reach 6 may stop and win immediately; if he continues and another reaches 6, that other wins alone. If no one reaches 6 the hand is drawn. Winner is paid by each loser, double by Vulnerable losers.
rating_reason: Multi-trick trick-taking, decision to play with payments strategic
